1.overview: A creature who blasted the moon into a crescent shows up at Kunugigaoka Junior High School--and he's giving the students a year to assassinate him!
1.summary:
A creature who blasted the moon into a crescent shows up at Kunugigaoka Junior High School--and he`s giving the students a year to assassinate him!
Source: crunchyroll

2.overview: The reasoning behind the E Class's segregation is revealed. Nagisa tracks Koro Sensei's weak points in the hopes of using them to take him down.

3.overview: The brilliant, belligerent Karma Akabane, Nagisa's former classmate, joins 3-E and immediately jumps into the assassination mission with both feet.
3.summary:

4.overview: A new foreign-language teacher comes to 3-E with some major ulterior motives... among other things. Will she get any closer to killing Koro Sensei?

7.overview: The students go on a school trip to Kyoto, where they must still keep assassination foremost in their minds. Kanzaki faces trouble from her past.
7.summary:
The students go on a school trip to Kyoto, where they must still keep assassination foremost in their minds. Kanzaki faces trouble from her past.

title.ja: 修学旅行の時間・2時間目

8.overview: The E Class gives a pro sniper plenty of chances to take down Koro Sensei, then try to make the most of what's left of their school trip to Kyoto.
8.summary:
The E Class gives a pro sniper plenty of chances to take down Koro Sensei, then try to make the most of what`s left of their school trip to Kyoto.
Source: crunchyroll

9.overview: A new student joins the E Class with a singleminded focus on assassination that drives her classmates to distraction. Koro Sensei to the rescue!
9.summary:
A new student joins the E Class with a singleminded focus on assassination that drives her classmates to distraction. Koro Sensei to the rescue!
Source: crunchyroll

10.overview: Irina is greeted by her former master, retired assassin Lovro, who thinks she should give up as she has no chance of killing Koro-sensei.
10.summary:
Prof. Jelavich is forced to prove her assassin chops when her mentor pays a visit. Koro Sensei takes Nagisa and Karma on a trip they`ll never forget.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 転校生の時間・2時間目

11.overview: Class 3-E prepare for the arrival of their second transfer student, who is allegedly more powerful than Ritsu.
11.summary:
Another new student throws everyone for a loop. His raw power is one thing, but what`s with these mysterious ties he claims to have with Koro Sensei?
Source: crunchyroll

12.overview: A baseball tournament is to be held, in which Class 3-E are forced to play an exhibition match against the top players of the school's baseball club, which Sugino used to be a part of.
12.summary:
The E Class boys must play the Baseball Club in an exhibition game meant to humiliate them. Can Koro Sensei`s unique coaching style make a difference?
Source: crunchyroll

13.overview: As Karasuma briefly senses what appears to be a fearsome aura coming from Nagisa, Akira Takaoka, an aquaintance of Karasuma from the Ministry of Defense, is sent to Class 3-E to take over Karasuma's role as P.E. teacher.
13.summary:
Jolly Mr. Takaoka comes to assist Mr. Karasuma with training, but his unconventional methods have everyone upset. Nagisa reveals a hidden talent.
Source: crunchyroll

14.overview: Koro Sensei exposes a major weakness, and Terasaka interrupts a fun summer day out with an assassination attempt that goes a little too far.
14.summary:
Koro Sensei exposes a major weakness, and Terasaka interrupts a fun summer day out with an assassination attempt that goes a little too far.
Source: crunchyroll

15.overview: For finals, Koro Sensei gives his class a new goal--with an irresistible reward. The E Class makes its own deal with the top-tier A Class's Big Five.
15.summary:

16.overview: After two days of exams, the results are in. Both the ace A Class and the end E Class must come to terms with the outcome--and so must Koro Sensei.

17.overview: The E Class trains intently under a pro killer to prepare for their island assassination. Once there, they must make sure everything falls into place.

19.overview: The E Class must put their lessons into practice as they tackle an intimidating hotel brimming with baddies--and all without Koro Sensei's help.

20.overview: Karma must use his head to get past a formidable foe. Nagisa goes undercover as the E Class continues to sneak its way to the hotel's top floor.

21.overview: The students take on one last assassin opponent before meeting the shadowy figure who's holding the virus remedy hostage in exhange for Koro Sensei.
21.summary:

22.overview: Before Nagisa completely gives into his anger, Terasaka throws a stun-gun at him, urging him not to become a murderer and think about what's truly important.
22.summary:
It`s a showdown on the roof of the Fukuma Denjo Hotel with the lives of half the E Class in the balance. Can Nagisa find a way to come out on top?
Source: crunchyroll
